title: Pro Raster/Vector Drawing, Masks & Layer Interop
objective: Provide or consume governed drawing-layer capabilities for raster and editable vector strokes, pressure-aware brushes, selections, masks, clipping, layer folders/comps and non-destructive filters while preferring PAPT or other existing studio owners for primitives and keeping SAA limited to comic-project composition semantics rather than a duplicate renderer.
acceptance: Raster and editable-vector drawing state integrates with existing SAA page/panel/layer identity instead of creating a parallel comic document model.
Pressure-aware brush operations remain explicit governed drawing operations with deterministic project/layer targets.
Selections, masks and clipping preserve source layer identity and remain reversible/non-destructive where declared.
Layer folders/comps compose existing governed SAA layers without replacing canonical project/layer identity.
Non-destructive filters retain their source relationship and cannot silently bake over canonical source state.
Existing PAPT or other studio primitive owners are consumed where applicable; SAA does not create a duplicate generic renderer or brush engine.
Provider-off/local authoring remains valid for core drawing-layer workflows.
SAA-24 and later finishing/3D/scroll/print/multimedia/interchange/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-23 owns comic-project drawing/layer interoperability semantics only; reusable primitive drawing/rendering authority remains with existing studio owners where already established.
No duplicate generic renderer, brush engine, asset ledger, Character/Scene/Dialogue/ARI/AAI or narrative ledger may be created.
Masks, clipping and filters cannot silently mutate source-domain truth or discard recoverable layer state.
No proprietary vendor code, private formats, assets, protected expression or undocumented protocols may be copied.
SAA-24 remains blocked until verified SAA-23 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-23.
